title: Cell (Godot)
launch_hint: godot_host launcher -> cell; the config must be in the cell allowlist
description: The flagellate cell in the Godot host (godot_host/project/scripts/body_controller.gd): whiskers, scent, energy, a first-person camera, two flagella.

sources.name: imu
sources.description: sin(h), cos(h), vx, vz - kinematic only (whiskers split off)

sources.name: whiskers
sources.description: per-whisker contact intensity, one topic per whisker: reality.proprio.whisker_0 .. whisker_5 (one EPM per channel)

sources.name: camera
sources.description: raw first-person RGB frame (food is green against a grey/blue scene)

sources.name: motor_energy
sources.description: per-flagellum leaky energy budget (drains with paddling, recharges at rest)

sinks.name: out
sinks.description: accel [-4,+4] -> per-flagellum spike rates (legacy single channel; superseded when left + right are both driven)

sinks.name: left
sinks.description: accel [-4,+4] -> left-flagellum spike rate; paired with action.right for differential steering

sinks.name: right
sinks.description: accel [-4,+4] -> right-flagellum spike rate; paired with action.left

events.name: eat
events.description: ground-truth consummatory event (real nutrient collision only)
